columns.description: Logical supplied-result column mappings, globally or by file role. Reserved result_metadata selects approved aggregate metadata aliases; role-specific selections can appear under columns.results.result_metadata.

endpoint.description: Provider-specific validation requires HTTPS for remote compatible endpoints and the literal loopback address/port/path for local models.

response_files.description: Paths to audited browser receipt.yaml files. May be absent initially; import then repeat the same run command.

public_literature_context.description: Explicit hash-pinned public-literature context specifications. Only selected ranges from verified native full-text reference-bundle members can enter their declared impact/manuscript purposes; absent by default.

impact.description: Study-wide AI impact assessment; defaults to true when manuscript assistance is requested.

related_phenotypes.description: Request a bounded, cited list of up to 20 related phenotype labels for public GWAS discovery. Suggestions remain unreviewed and do not amend hypotheses.

manuscript_max_output_tokens.description: Provider output budget; the separate manuscript policy declares a flexible main-text target or an explicit strict limit, with complete supplementary discussion retained.

credential_file.description: Absolute path to a password-encrypted credential file outside the study project. Never copied into evidence.

credential_password_env.description: Optional secret-manager password variable name. Without it, unlock through a masked console once per CLI invocation.

mr_testing_families.description: Explicit primary MR reporting families spanning at least two active hypotheses. Sources retain their original corrections. Joint discoveries require every source family to be complete. This does not merge causal estimands or establish valid instruments.

word_limit_mode.description: New default manuscripts use target: exceeding 8000 main-text words records an editorial warning and preserves extended supplements. An explicitly supplied legacy max_main_words without this field remains strict. Explicit journal limits can use strict.

resources.description: Public reference policy. Downloads are automatic by default. An omitted directory uses the user-level shared resource cache when configured, otherwise the project-local resources directory.

literature_name.description: Public cohort name for design-paper searches; never patient information.

supplied_result_id.description: ID of the primary supplied analysis representing this metadata-only dataset in the hypothesis.

columns.description: Logical column mappings for a dataset. A blank leading CSV header used for R row names is available as __row_name__.

result_mode.description: Explicit file-wide P-only declaration permits absent beta/SE columns; supplied P values remain required.

resultMetadata.description: Typed aggregate result metadata mappings. Conventional numeric and allele/count headers are recognized automatically; ambiguous aliases require explicit selection. Labels require explicit mappings. Missing values remain unavailable; unknown participant or free-text columns are never copied.

columnValidation.description: Optional eligibility checks applied before result harmonization.

collection.description: Defaults to GMT when gene_sets is supplied, otherwise GO.

phenotype.description: Native cohort-specific independent Gaussian identity OLS Freedman-Lane residual permutation. Requires null_model phenotype and no external ranking/null_rankings. General nuisance calibration remains approximate.

null_rankings.description: Complete shared model-null ranking ensemble. TSV blocks use exact header draw_id, gene_id, statistic and every draw must match the complete observed gene universe. Source scientific/calibration claims remain declarations.

complete_missing.description: Complete native cohort networks not covered by supplied primary graph scopes. False processes only supplied graphs when any are supplied.

poolingPolicy.description: Declared compatible effect block and conditional sampling covariance. Incomplete legacy contracts remain explicitly uncertified.

variantFollowupPolicy.description: Whole-universe functional consequences and contextual AlphaGenome scores; no significance-based selection. REF agreement requires the supplied FASTA. Indels require an explicit normalization declaration.

installation.description: Automatic private SDK setup by default when no external Python is supplied. Software installation does not provide model API credentials.

maximum_external_af.description: Maximum ALT AC/AN across the declared external populations; defaults to maximum_maf only when external_frequency is enabled.

literature_max_features.description: Separate significant-feature literature budget. An existing explicit max_features remains the fallback when this field is omitted.

literature_selection.description: Before capping literature targets, auto uses provisional impact assistance when enabled for impact; otherwise source P ordering. Impact requires a complete provisional comparison and never falls back on failure. Completed supplied literature is reused.

literature_max_queries.description: Audited query-use budget for literature_search only; other public-evidence operations retain their 200-query limit.

remote_feature_queries.description: Opt in to provider queries containing selected genes or genomic regions. The default GWAS discovery sends public phenotype labels only.

literature_terms.description: Public molecular-field search terms; inferred from dataset type when omitted. Never put patient information here.

feature_source.description: Contextual literature/protein/sequence selection; rare-set tests do not become molecular MR exposure estimates.

colocalizationSourcePolicy.description: Automatic exploratory irQTL-GWAS colocalization discovery. Related phenotype labels are searched in GWAS Catalog; indexed harmonized regional results are preferred. Partial QTL regions can be analyzed only with a mandatory major caveat.

mrTestingPolicy.description: Separate primary MR testing family within one hypothesis. A single instrument uses Wald ratio; multi-instrument primary IVW is selected before results. Pending/unanalyzable hypotheses remain in the denominator, with unavailable P values and explicit coverage dispositions.

mrSourcePolicy.description: Concise automatic cis-irQTL MR source policy. JLinAlg expands it into audited per-feature pairs. Custom sources continue to use genetic_pairs.

exposure_ancestry.description: Explicit ancestry of the actual irQTL analysis sample; never inferred from the cohort name.

outcome_trait.description: BMI aliases/UK Biobank field 21001 or obesity aliases/ICD-10 E66 select the corresponding built-in Pan-UKB adapter.

max_features.description: Optional explicit cap on primary full-family significant measured features, applied before annotation or QTL matching. Omit for all eligible features, including missing/ambiguous annotations. Independent of contextual/literature feature limits; source-adjusted P and denominator are preserved. Missing locations remain prerequisites, not null results.

geneticPair.description: Scientist-reviewed regional evidence. Missing scientific prerequisites are documented as questions at execution, never guessed.

ld.description: A cited local signed matrix and allele file, a population for automatic 1000G GRCh37 LD, or database 1000g-30x-grch38 plus a superpopulation for indexed GRCh38 regional LD.

effectOutliers.description: Audited per-dataset association-estimate QC before comparisons, FDR and downstream analyses. Conservative scale-aware heuristic, not proof of invalidity. Raw inputs are preserved; common_universe=intersection propagates exclusions across cohorts. Historical results require a new approved run.

robust_z.description: Exclude when abs(beta-median(beta))/robust_scale is strictly above this threshold. Scale uses normal-consistent MAD with IQR fallback; zero-scale families are not screened relatively.

max_abs_effect.description: Optional unit-specific absolute coefficient bound. Applies even below min_features; no universal absolute bound is inferred.

riskScorePolicy.description: Explicit training/tuning/evaluation partitions; frozen supplied scores or weights; conditional independent-unit bootstrap and separate related-phenotype family. Missing design inputs remain prerequisites. Native training is quantitative, not logistic or survival.

binary_baseline_lambda.description: Positive covariate ridge penalty on standardized non-intercept covariates, used for joint and baseline binary models.

nested_validation.description: Grouped nested validation inside the registered training+tuning pool. Native train/refit only; independent evaluation excluded. Unavailable folds hold the whole validation family.

proteinPolicy.description: Exact sequence/taxon/isoform mapping with supplied, versioned retrieved or configured-predicted models. Confidence and directional PAE are model context, not statistical or functional validation. Manifest scope is explicit; raw coordinates and sequences remain local. Prediction network intent is source-declared, not OS isolation.

cohortOverlapPolicy.description: Exact descriptive multiway membership, explicit coverage and source/frozen testing families. Limits constrain work or displayed patterns, without deleting source results.

heterogeneityPolicy.description: Registered feature/widespread heterogeneity rules and common-universe influence. Conventional I-squared or complete Q testing families; no minimum-heterogeneity primary optimization.

colocalizationPolicy.description: Registered SuSiE/colocalization priors, optional posterior decision rule and complete regional coverage/reporting bounds. Source discovery remains in bioinformatics.colocalization. Cross-field prior constraints are validated by JLinAlg.

chromosome_scope.description: Native Cox genotype default: human_autosomes. Other association routes retain their existing all default. Unsupported Cox ploidy/related designs need a matching workflow.

annotation_mode.description: binary preserves fixed aggregate-annotation initial weights. mixed requires explicit annotation_type/sum columns and full reference cross-products; uses fixed all-SNP baseline initial weights, binary category tests and continuous conditional coefficient tests.

reviewedFeatureLocation.description: Explicit sourced location of the exact measured molecular feature in an approved MR pair. Does not infer or resolve a gene annotation. Known sealed-location conflicts remain blocked; end must be at or after start.

pca_source.description: Defaults to the sample-QC source; native completes explicitly requested missing PCA.

dataset_coverage.description: Declared completeness of selected genomic dataset exports; no source validity is inferred.

rareOmnibusPolicy.description: Prespecified cross-mask set/gene omnibus with a separate scoped testing family; original component P/q values remain retained.

humanPloidyPolicy.description: One registered independent human chromosome/complement contrast. Requires explicitly human genotype datasets with matching genome_build and files.ploidy_samples. Complements are caller declarations, never inferred sex or certified karyotypes. PAR uses X coordinates only. Physical allele copies determine MAC before imputation. Different contrasts remain separate estimands/testing families.

haploid_source_scale.description: observed requires observed source ploidy 1; haploid explicitly declares 0..1 copies when source ploidy is unknown; diploid explicitly declares 0..2 coding and divides by two. Fractional hard-call values are invalid after conversion.

unknown_samples.description: Missing or unsupported complement labels (including aneuploid labels) error or are explicitly excluded.

networkNullPolicy.description: Opt-in conditional frozen-edge target-label permutation tests. Validity requires prespecified within-stratum node-label exchangeability; this is not participant resampling, association selection or WGCNA Zsummary.

rareFrequencyPolicy.description: Optional prespecified external ALT AC/AN panel. Missing required source metadata/coverage pauses native mask construction; no missing-frequency-as-zero rule.

enabled.description: Defaults to true for a nonempty policy and false when absent.

minimum_allele_number.description: Explicit required coverage threshold; no universal scientific default.

survivalPolicy.description: Native independent baseline-covariate Cox contract. Missing required endpoint/assumption fields generate runtime prerequisite requests; completed supplied results do not imply native execution.

likelihood_tolerance.description: NNLS search tolerance only; final finite/monotone certificates use exact arithmetic on input double values. Unresolved checks hold the complete native family.
